import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item
from store.coupons import CouponError


def test_issue_save10_mug_and_shirt():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="TSHIRT", name="T-shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 370  # (1200 + 2500) * 10 // 100 = 370


def test_issue_save10_quantities():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="TSHIRT", name="T-shirt", price_cents=2500, qty=3))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 990  # 1200*2 + 2500*3 = 9900; 9900*10//100 = 990


def test_issue_halfoff_whole_subtotal():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="TSHIRT", name="T-shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 1850  # (1200 + 2500) * 50 // 100 = 1850


def test_issue_percent_rounds_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="PENNY", name="Penny item", price_cents=333))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 33  # 333*10//100 = 33


def test_issue_percent_empty_cart():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 0  # 0*10//100 = 0


def test_issue_save10_shipping_below_threshold():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more; otherwise it is a flat $5.99."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=3000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=2400))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 599  # 3000+2400=5400; 5400*10//100=540; 5400-540=4860 < 5000 => 599


def test_issue_save10_shipping_at_threshold():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more; otherwise it is a flat $5.99."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=3000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=2555))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # 3000+2555=5555; 5555*10//100=555; 5555-555=5000 >= 5000 => 0


def test_contract_subtotal_sums_lines():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line in the cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="TSHIRT", name="T-shirt", price_cents=2500, qty=1))
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 4900  # 1200*2 + 2500*1 = 4900


def test_contract_add_same_sku():
    """Adding a SKU that is already in the cart increases that line's qty."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=1))
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 2  # 1 + 1 = 2


def test_contract_second_coupon_raises():
    """At most one coupon may be applied to a cart. Applying a second coupon raises CouponError."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):
        cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")


def test_contract_fixed_minimum():
    """A fixed coupon takes a flat amount off, but only when the subtotal is at least the coupon's minimum."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 0  # subtotal 1200 < min 2000 => 0


def test_contract_tax_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="WIDGET", name="Widget", price_cents=1234))
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 99  # 1234*8/100 = 98.72 rounds to 99


def test_contract_total_formula():
    """Total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax, and is never negative."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="BIG", name="Big", price_cents=3000))
    assert cart.total_cents() == 3839  # tax 3000*8/100=240; 3000 + 599 + 240 = 3839


def test_contract_shipping_empty():
    """An empty cart has no shipping charge."""
    cart = Cart()
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # empty => 0
